_comment: sim-robust-weld-attach-v1. Both robustness levers ship EFFECTIVE BY DEFAULT in code, so the collect1 mission runtime-config needs NO edit to get them -- this fragment only documents the switch keys and their env overrides for reference and for reproducing a pre-fix run. (1) The SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK weld now forms within a tolerant gap (default 3 mm, was 0.5 mm) so the grasp attaches square-on at the natural contact-descent endpoint instead of depending on sub-mm jitter crossing exactly 0.5 mm -- runs 321/327 (honest collect) bottomed at 0.67 mm and NEVER welded -> 'arm command heartbeat lost'; collect1/collectsrc (ground-truth) only crossed 0.5 mm by jitter (0.48/0.50 mm). (2) The grasp-press sim-clock budget (PR 203) now defaults ON (45 s SIM) so a non-forming grasp -- which keeps the host ALIVE, so the pace-aware heartbeat does NOT trip -- fails fast with a NAMED reason instead of looping to the coarse 120 s phase_timeout.
_grasp_press_timeout_s_note: SIM seconds (node/sim clock, render-pacing-safe -- NOT wall). Omit the key entirely to take the code default (45 s, env RESTOCK_GRASP_PRESS_TIMEOUT_S). Set to 0 to DISABLE (reproduce a pre-fix run). The sibling sim-robust-collect-arrival-v1 fragment suggested 10 s, but the slowest observed LEGITIMATE press (ground-truth collect, run collect1) was ~13.4 sim s, so the default is 45 s (>3x) to avoid false-failing a slow-but-healthy descent; the controller re-clamps to <= phase_timeout (120 s).

_switch_keys.RESTOCK_SIM_ATTACH_CONTACT_MM: env (mm), default 3.0, clamped (0.05 .. REAL_MAX_GRIP_DISTANCE*1000 = 5.0]. Set to 0.5 to reproduce the pre-fix fragile gate. The pad-tilt gate (SIM_ATTACH_FLUSH_DEG=2 deg) is UNCHANGED -- a tolerant gap must still be square-on.
_switch_keys.RESTOCK_GRASP_PRESS_TIMEOUT_S: env (SIM seconds), default 45.0; the config key 'grasp_press_timeout_s' overrides it.

_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the collect1 config on branch fm/sim-robust-weld-attach-v1 under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (ground-truth collect, the collect1 config). EXPECT: the collect GRASP seals deterministically (SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK attach gap_mm <= 3, no 'grasp press exceeded' / no 'arm command heartbeat lost' at the grasp). NOTE: the full collect+couple proof ALSO needs the place-on-cart blocker fixed -- collect1 & collectsrc both fail at the PLACE-on-cart step (collect1 'collision planning or execution failed' cuMotion; collectsrc host-heartbeat silence), which is owned by sim-robust-collect-place-v1 / PR 200, NOT this lane. To validate THIS lane's grasp fix in isolation, scope the proof to the pick (e.g. a pick-only / --stop-after collect-pick bench) or run with the sim-robust-collect-place-v1 fixes also in effect.
